profile.Civilian Appearance:
Joe is a tall, well-built young man with broad shoulders and a gentle, approachable appearance. He has short, dark hair, warm brown eyes, and a naturally calm expression. His everyday clothing is usually simple and comfortable, favouring neutral colours and practical outfits. Although his height and build can make him appear intimidating at first glance, his soft-spoken manner quickly puts people at ease.

profile.Passed Tests: Planned — Support (Barrier, Healer, Researcher), Strategist, Shadow
profile.Signature Ability: Planned — Guardian's Shelter; a reinforced Earth barrier that protects allies and civilians within a designated area. Unlike ordinary barriers that rely entirely on blocking attacks, his barrier distributes incoming force across its structure, reducing the likelihood of a single concentrated strike breaking through. His inherited Fire allows him to manipulate temperature within a controlled area. Rather than generating traditional flames, he can increase or decrease temperatures, allowing him to regulate the environment around those he protects.
profile.Strengths: Defensive magic, barriers, endurance, patience, reliability, observation, leadership, teamwork, emotional awareness, and remaining calm under pressure.
profile.Weaknesses: Coffea has a tendency to shoulder responsibility without asking for help. His protective instincts can make him reluctant to retreat, especially when someone important to him remains in danger. struggles to express his own emotional needs, often prioritising the comfort of others over himself.
profile.Fear: Being unable to protect someone despite being physically present. He is particularly afraid of surviving an incident in which someone he loves is seriously harmed because he could not reach them in time. Losing Blossom.
profile.Mentor: Luma Blossom; Luma Flora is not officially registered.
profile.Relationship: Single; later develops a romantic relationship with Luma Blossom (Lumina).
profile.Close bonds: Luma Fractal (Felix), Luma Aster (Amelia), Luma Marigold (Aurelia), Luma Blossom (Lumina), Luma EmberFlora (Sylvia)
profile.Loves: Spending quality time with people he cares about, peaceful evenings, thoughtful gestures, and seeing his loved ones happy and safe.
profile.Likes: Coffee, home-cooked meals, quiet conversations, gentle teasing, comfortable environments, and spending time with close friends.
profile.Dislikes: Unnecessary conflict, reckless decisions that endanger others, people refusing help when clearly overwhelmed, and being unable to contribute during emergencies.
profile.Hates: Bullying, cruelty towards vulnerable people, betrayal of trust, and deliberately abusing one's authority or strength.
profile.Hobbies: Making coffee, cooking, baking, exercising, gaming with friends, and trying new cafés.
profile.Catchphrase: "I've got you. Just focus on what's ahead."
profile.Personality:
Joe is gentle, patient and dependable, with a calm presence that makes people feel safe around him. He tends to speak softly and rarely reacts impulsively, preferring to observe first and act once he understands the situation.
Although naturally kind, he is not passive. When someone is in danger or Wildflowers needs direction, Joe becomes firm and decisive. He is comfortable taking responsibility and often helps keep the team grounded under pressure, making him a natural leader.
Joe is usually composed around most people, but Lumina brings out a noticeably more playful side of him. He enjoys teasing her, deliberately trying to get reactions out of her and occasionally pushing just enough to make her flustered. The teasing is rarely mean-spirited; it is one of the ways he becomes more openly affectionate around her before he even realises he likes her.
He is deeply loyal and protective, but prefers standing beside the people he cares about rather than controlling their decisions. With Lumina especially, he often watches her without noticing he is doing it, stays close when she is around, and remembers small details about her long before he understands why.
Personality Example: During a dangerous mission, Joe remains calm while coordinating the safety of his teammates. Rather than issuing unnecessary commands, he focuses on ensuring everyone understands the situation and has a safe way to respond.

Joe notices when Lumina is unusually quiet or exhausted. Instead of immediately questioning her, he may quietly prepare something for her to eat or drink, allowing her to rest without feeling pressured to explain herself.
Around Lumina, Joe occasionally attempts to tease or flirt with her, only to discover that her completely unintentional responses are far more effective at making him flustered.
When a teammate insists they are fine despite obvious exhaustion, Joe does not argue endlessly. He simply takes over part of their responsibility and calmly tells them to rest.
profile.Fever Behaviour: Coffea becomes unusually clingy and dependent on Lumina when feverish, insisting on keeping her within his sight at all times. He develops an irrational fear that she might disappear the moment he looks away, becoming visibly anxious whenever she leaves the room. He often reaches for her hand or holds onto her clothing for reassurance. As his fever worsens, he becomes more restless and distressed, occasionally pleading with her not to leave him, even when she is only stepping away briefly.
profile.Intoxicated Behaviour: Joe becomes unusually affectionate, clingy, and physically expressive when intoxicated, particularly toward Lumina. He frequently pats her head, hugs her from behind, and buries his face in her hair, occasionally breathing in her familiar scent for comfort. He becomes reluctant to let her go, often following her around or pulling her closer whenever she moves away. His usual emotional restraint disappears, making his affection for her much more obvious, although he rarely realises how openly he is displaying it.
profile.Core Idea of character: Coffee, loyalty, protection and quiet devotion.
Quotes: “She chose to stand between the world and everyone behind her. I chose to stand beside her.”
“If she was going to keep choosing everyone else, then I wanted to be the person who chose her.”
profile.Background:
He was Emergency Awakened by Luma Blossom on 17 October 2025, leaving traces of her Fire power within his Core.
His Earth magic specialises in defensive barriers, stability, and endurance. Unlike Blossom's flame-based abilities, Coffea's inherited Fire manifests through temperature manipulation, allowing him to regulate heat and control the temperature of his surroundings. This complements his defensive abilities and provides additional support during rescue missions.
Within Wildflowers, Coffea gradually becomes the team's leader. Calm, dependable, and protective, he prefers standing alongside his teammates rather than commanding them from above.
Joe has been attracted to Lumina since their university days, although he takes time to recognise his feelings. He eventually decides to wait until becoming a Full-Fledged Guardian before confessing, hoping to stand beside her as an equal rather than solely as her disciple.
As his training progresses, his close friendship with Felix, Amelia, and Aurelia strengthens, forming the foundation of Wildflowers' teamwork.
